code:
(define L (list 'a 'b 'c))
(car L)                      ; a
(cdr L)                      ; (b c)

(define x (+ 3 2))
(+ x 5)                      ; 10

(define add +)
(add 3 2)                    ; 5
description: Define lists and values, access with car and cdr, and bind names to procedures.

steps.description: Reveal list definition and access: L is a list, car returns first element, cdr returns rest.

steps.question: What does (cdr L) return for L defined as (list 'a 'b 'c)?

steps.description: Reveal value definition: x is (+ 3 2) equals 5, then used in (+ x 5).
Reveal procedure binding: add is bound to +, then called with (add 3 2).
Run to show car L returns a.
Run to show cdr L returns (b c).

title: Definitions and List Access
